scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shell,sales,customers "npm run dev -w @opsboard/shell" "npm run dev -w @opsboard/sales" "npm run dev -w @opsboard/customers"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @opsboard/sales -w @opsboard/customers && npm run build -w @opsboard/shell
scripts.start:all: concurrently -k -n shell,sales,customers "npm run start -w @opsboard/shell" "npm run preview -w @opsboard/sales" "npm run preview -w @opsboard/customers"
